_about: What a Mermaid diagram is drawn with, on screen and (later) by the server's renderer: one engine version, one font and the same limits, so a diagram reads the same in a report as on the page. `version` must equal the `mermaid` pin in package.json (a story checks it); the server's own copy of these values is checked against this file by backend/tests/test_markdown_text.py.
